notes: MULTIFAMILY REPEATED-UNIT CASE. Brittany Park is a 43-dwelling-unit apartment building (King County Housing Authority) and the set draws exactly ONE typical unit — Sheet E601 'TYPICAL ENLARGED DWELLING UNIT FLOOR PLANS', labelled 'typ. unit 117'. The whole-project unit count is stated on Sheet E002 in the 'KCHA - Brittany Park' unit-type matrix: Total Upgraded Units = 37, Total Classic Units = 6, i.e. 43 units; Sheet E800's two apartment-unit load calculations agree (MC-A&B TOTAL = 23 units, MC-C&D TOTAL = 20 units). Per-unit work must therefore be scaled to the project, and the split matters: E002 electrical calculation note 3 provides a NEW 25A/2P breaker only in the 37 UPGRADED (remodel) panelboards, while the 6 CLASSIC units reuse their existing 30A/2P baseboard-heater breaker (Sheet E601 demo-plan general note 2). So the correct whole-project count for the new breaker is 37, NOT 43 and NOT 1. Every quantity below is whole-project. Conduit and conductor lengths are not dimensioned anywhere on the set, so those are null by design rather than derived. This is a retrofit: Sheet E001/E002/E201-E204 general note 1 says ALL PANELS SHOWN ARE EXISTING TO REMAIN and Sheet E800 says the one-line 'IS EXISTING AND TO REMAIN... FOR REFERENCE ONLY', so the existing service, switchboard, transformer, meter centers, house panels and dwelling-unit panelboards are NOT procured — see `forbidden`. Sources read as rendered images: E002 (schedules, unit matrix, calculation notes), E601 (typical unit), E800 (one-line + load calculations). Sheets E201-E204 (floor plans) and E900 (panel schedules) were not enumerated, hence partial.
